title: Shaka Purushuni Jananam – Pastor John Wesley Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: వచ్చాడు మహారాజు మరి మనకోసమే అండగా తోడుగా
english: Vachaadu maharaju mari manakosame andagaa thodugaa
manakosame mahimanu vidachi bhuvike rakshananu thechaadu
Maatathone srushtini chesina entho goppa devudu
mamu kaachi penchi premisthunna yekaika devudu
Narulanu preminchi paramunu vidachi manishiga puttinadu
nee hrudhayamu koradu mari emi adagaledhu
maaru manasu pondhi manamu mokshamey cheredhamu
intro: Shaka Purushuni Jananam is the latest Telugu Christmas song written by Sangeetha Rao, sung by Senior Pastor, Singer, song-writer, international speaker by Pastor John Wesley and music composed by Bobby Karra. This worship song video was released on December 24, 2021 through Bobby Karra YouTube channel.
